name: plan-architect
description: Turn an agreed architecture into an execution plan with walking-skeleton milestones, actionable tasks, dependencies, acceptance gates, risks, and rollout considerations. Accepts spec-architect output or other designs after an explicit readiness review. A bundled Python validator checks plan coverage, references, and dependency consistency; architecture decisions remain upstream.

interface.longDescription: Sequence an agreed architecture through Readiness, Milestones, Tasks, and Validation. Default to an early executable path across real integration boundaries. Author plan.json and generate a readable Markdown plan plus a structural validation report using a bundled Python 3.9+ tool. Scheduling values are included only when supplied. A structural pass still requires semantic review; execution remains a separate step.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my agreed architecture into a walking-skeleton execution plan with milestones, tasks, dependencies, and validation.
